attBesluta.text: Trés bons pieds de table robustes de fabrication bien finie avec patins de réglage de niveau. Montés sous un grand plateau bois, l'ensemble forme une belle table de travail.
Au top, belles finitions, réglages simples et efficaces, pour le design ça dépend des goûts de chacun, mais le rendu est fidèle aux photos.

Belle gambe, solide, appensantite con la sabbia (dal rumore che fanno quando le giri su se stesse). colore ben fatto. Se le fissate (come me) ad un tavolino fatto di legno di 10mm non potete fissarle con le viti autofilettanti in dotazione, dovrete usare qualche cosa di grosso e corto da legno. I piedini sono ben fatti e di una gomma a quanto sembra resistente. Arrivate abbastanza velocemente avendo il maga di spedizione in europa e no spese dogana!!!

For the price, a very nice pair of legs. I combined it with a birch tabletop. Looks good. I didn't use the included screws. I put threaded inserts in the birchtabletop. I didn't find the little feet looked good, and the table was too high with them. They are absolutely not necessary if your floor is level, and the table looks much better without them. Overall, great legs, especially at this price.

I couldn’t be more pleased. Sturdy, pretty, easy enough to assemble. I’d like more shelves and posts for it. I figure they expect some of the spaces to be bigger and I just need a bunch of tiny spots but all in all very happy.

This unit arrived free of any damage, and was a breeze to assemble with the tool provided. This shelving unit is very sturdy and perfect for holding and organizing lots of items, including paper, fabric memos. I would love it if it came with extra shelves and pins. I would Also love if Vevor sold replacement packs of shelves and pins for this product.

I have purchased 6 of these 36-compartment organizers because they are very useful, affordable, and durable. They work great to organize fabric samples. They come very well packaged, with damage so far! They are easy and quick to assemble, and once together, very stable. I LOVE the flexibility of the slot size. Perfect for my purposes, and very affordable!

Came with mounting hardware for mounting to backboard or masonry. I built my own backboard out of 3/4 plywood. The hoop appears sturdy and is match in strength to the plywood when pulling down on the hoop.
Great hook, strong and quality! Also stood firmly the entire of North Dakota winter without any damage.
Easy to install and a lot better than the original that was on the backboard

I used this as a replacement rim after a storm. It is better quality than the original (on a fairly premium portable goal). My only issue is that the bolt pattern didn't match perfectly and only three bolt out of four would line up. Depending on your goal, you may need a plan to expand one slightly. Quick work with a proper drill or not a big deal with a rotary grinding wheel/Dremel style tool.
